title: Model search keeps up with your typing
summary:
Model search stopped losing keystrokes; app listings and the README got their daily tending.

Enter now filters models as you type instead of waiting for URL navigation, so delayed responses no longer undo newer searches or a cleared field. Search matches the displayed model title and brand.

The app catalog and greenhouse listings were updated with July 21 metrics and health-check results.

The README now recaps July 20 embedding and Cohere updates, has rewritten descriptions for all 132 models, and clarifies allowlist requests for publishing public community models.
